div.div: تَرَكْتُهُمْ مُرْتَثِدِينَ مَا تَحَمَّلُوا بَعْدُ means I left them putting their goods, or utensils and furniture, one upon another, (T, * S, M, * L, K,) without having that whereon to remove them, (S, L,) [not having yet taken them up and departed:] thus مُرْتَثِدُونَ differs from رَثَدٌ [q. v.]. (S, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
